gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, on 2026-11-27, EcoFlow's own US store lists a 3,600 W, 3 kWh-class unit (DELTA 3000 Gen4, $1,299) only $150 above the 3,000 W / 2,048 Wh DELTA 3 Max Plus ($1,149) that ChatGPT picked, nor that two of ChatGPT's three picks are constrained at the maker (Anker F3000 marked Sold Out with 3–7 week shipping; DELTA 3 Ultra marked 'Limited Stock Remaining. No Restock Planned').
standout_why: Compared against rvgearlab (cited; 6 models, undated prices, no weights), powerstationsrated (cited; 16 models, price bands only, 'November 2026'), wattsift (cited; undated prices, F3000 at $1,699.99, DELTA 3 Ultra at $1,599), truewattlab (cited; undated street-price bands), powerstations.reviews/jackery-3000 (cited; the strongest rival, with maker prices dated Nov 2–23 for F3000, DELTA 3 Ultra, Pecron F3000LFP, Dabbsson 3000L, ALLPOWERS R3500 and Mango Power E) and outagehouse (no prices). Rivals therefore already have part of this: dated maker prices for most of the line. As far as the page summaries I read show, none lists the DELTA 3000 Gen4, the F3000 sold-out and 3–7 week notice, the DELTA 3 Ultra no-restock notice or the Pecron mid-December pre-order, and none carries a price dated after Nov 23. Only powerstations.reviews lists the ALLPOWERS R3500; none lists the BLUETTI Apex 200. I read rival pages through a summarising fetch, so a mention buried deep in a page could have been missed.
decides: It weakens ChatGPT's pick. The DELTA 3 Max Plus is the lowest-capacity unit in the line at about $0.56/Wh, and EcoFlow's own store sells 3,600 W continuous and a 3 kWh-class battery for $150 more. The F3000 cannot be the pick while Anker's page shows Sold Out and 3–7 weeks. On watt-hours per dollar among units read today: Pecron F3000LFP $0.29/Wh (pre-order, ships mid-December, inside the four-week rule), Dabbsson 3000L about $0.32/Wh if the $969 is the unit alone, ALLPOWERS R3500 $0.38/Wh at its $1,199 store price (about $0.33/Wh at the $1,055.12 code price in your table). The R3500 is therefore an honest top-three on Wh per dollar and the best-placed row you link, but not #1 against Pecron at $899. The Apex 200 at $1,149 falls under the four-week shipping rule if the mid-February 2027 date in your notes still holds; I could not re-read that date. The desk-research placement 'DJI Power 2000 #1 on price' is unconfirmed: I could not open a DJI price today.
